dimensions.obligation_correctness: Recover accepted command and visit publication lifetimes.
dimensions.evidence_grounding: Cite the complete visible README and source.
dimensions.failure_prediction: Predict lost retry commands, stale notices, owner theft and uncanceled transfers.
dimensions.unsupported_claim_penalty: Do not require particular variable names or abandon accepted commands on navigation.

obligations.statement: Cancel the previous transfer before enqueueing an accepted retry.
obligations.event_relation: Previous native abort precedes retry enqueue.
obligations.failure_if_violated: Old and retry transfers remain active together.

obligations.statement: An accepted retry retains its entry file and visit, queues once and records once even after navigation.
obligations.failure_if_violated: Retry is dropped, duplicated, or retargeted.
required_concepts: command acceptance differs from view ownership

obligations.statement: A retired visit emits no queued notice, including after identical-file reopening; current retries remain live.
obligations.event_relation: Visit retirement precedes exclusion of subsequent notices.
obligations.failure_if_violated: Old queued status appears in the newer visit or hidden panel.
required_concepts: visit identity differs from file identity

obligations.statement: Newer navigation keeps its transfer owner and remains usable for retry and hide; no retired transfer stays active.
obligations.event_relation: Abort callback navigation precedes older retry continuation.
obligations.failure_if_violated: The outer retry steals the newer handle or leaves an abandoned transfer.
required_concepts: canceling a retained retired command cannot cancel a newer owner

obligations.statement: Cancellation and disposal are idempotent, hidden retry is a no-op, and independent workspaces stay independent.
obligations.event_relation: Workspace retirement prevents new commands only in that workspace.
obligations.failure_if_violated: Repeated callbacks or shared counters revoke unrelated work.

obligations.statement: Queue records retain their existing fields unless byteCount is explicitly granted.
obligations.failure_if_violated: Unrequested schema expansion or omitted authorized byteCount.
required_concepts: scope and temporal correctness are distinct

obligations.statement: A retired visit accepts no new progress; accepted decoding still records history, while visible progress requires a current visit.
obligations.event_relation: Admission precedes decoding; retirement ends new admission, not accepted history work.
obligations.failure_if_violated: Retired listeners accept new frames or accepted decode history is lost.
